about: What tools/score_build.py cuts the film's score from, and at what level each passage sits before the mix (dB, RMS; the mix then rides these under the voices). The theme's bar lines are measured: the file opens with 26 ms of nothing, runs at 144.016 beats a minute, and its drop lands 13.358 s in (the steepest rise in level, in 1 ms steps; the hits after it fall on whole beats). To try another theme, such as one made with Google's Lyria from audio/music/LYRIA_PROMPT.md: save it in audio/music/, run python3 tools/score_build.py --map FILE, put its file name, tempo and the time of its drop here, and run the tool and the mix again.
